claims.paper_statement: CAffNet satisfies arbitrary finite input-dependent affine inequality constraints.

claims.paper_statement: CAffNet supplies a jointly trainable null-space path beyond fixed projections.
claims.scope: Projector/gradient identities and five-seed controls pass; fixed orthogonal end-to-end training reaches its oracle, qualifying stronger uniqueness or universal-superiority wording.

claims.paper_statement: CAffNet preserves universal approximation while enforcing hard constraints.
claims.scope: Proof chain and exact Theorem 3.5 constant under the paper assumptions; finite training is not a universality proof.
